an5.145:1.1: pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye
an5.145:1.3: pāṇātipātī hoti adinnādāyī hoti kāmesu micchācārī hoti musāvādī hoti surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhāyī hoti
an5.145:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
an5.145:2.1: pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge
an5.145:2.3: pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti kāmesu micchācārā paṭivirato hoti musāvādā paṭivirato hoti surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti
an5.145:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ saggeti.
